title: Audit Support and Assurance Services
summary: Audit readiness, internal audit, controls and SOP review, and fraud and anomaly checks. We do not perform statutory audit.
metaTitle: Audit Support: Audit Readiness and Internal Audit
metaDescription: Audit support for India and the GCC: audit readiness, internal audit, controls and SOP review and fraud checks. Independent of your statutory auditor.
heroIntro: Stronger controls. Calmer audits. We help you tighten processes and prepare for audit, and we stay independent of your auditor.
overview:
Audits go smoothly when the schedules, reconciliations and working papers are ready before fieldwork starts, and when the controls behind them are sound. Our audit support services cover both: preparing for the audit and strengthening the processes it tests.

Statutory audit and tax audit are carried out by an independent auditor appointed directly by you, under a separate engagement. No fees flow between us and that auditor.
whatWeDo: Prepare closing schedules, reconciliations and working papers before fieldwork.
Track the auditor’s request list to completion and draft responses to queries.
Review balances, provisions and related-party disclosures before the audit.
Run risk-based internal audits of key finance cycles.
Document processes, approvals and delegation of authority.
Test for duplicate payments, unusual journals and payroll anomalies.

byPlan.foundation: Audit readiness available as a project.
byPlan.growth: Audit readiness included, with auditor query support.
byPlan.cfo: Included, with a pre-audit review of key balances.

note: Independence comes first. We offer internal audit only to clients whose books we do not maintain, or through a separate team with disclosure and safeguards.
